channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on James Jones, Josh Bartelstein
item.description:
“Josh (Bartelstein) and James (Jones) do a great job of including me when appropriate, getting my thoughts, my opinions and then they do their job.”

Mike Budenholzer on James Jones, Josh Bartelstein, Feb 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on James Jones
item.description:
“He said he just saw the news and I saw it right after. I was just sitting in my hotel room, honestly, just chilling. The Suns called me probably two minutes after it came out. [Suns general manager] James Jones called me.”

Mikal Bridges on James Jones, Feb 24, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Monty Williams on James Jones
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on James Jones' extension:

“I was happy for him. Anytime you can hang around as long as he has, that's a huge accomplishment. He's earned it for sure. The decisions he's made, the culture he's established has put us in the position we're in for sure.”

Monty Williams on James Jones, Jan 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: LeBron James on James Jones
item.description:
“I miss my teammates more than anything. The camaraderie that we had and the guys that are still here and the guys that are not still here like Shane (Battier) and Ray (Allen) — I still have Mike (Miller) with me, and (James Jones) — but all the guys, we built something that will last forever.”

LeBron James on James Jones, Dec 26, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Chris Bosh on James Jones, Mario Chalmers
item.description:
Chris Bosh:

“I’m sure I’ll be playing a lot more five. It’s kind of cool because I can say, ‘I’m the starting center for NBA champions.’’’ When Bosh said, that he changed his voice in a funny mannerHeat held team a party Sunday with James Jones as roast-master. Jones' zingers for Mario Chalmers included:”

Chris Bosh on James Jones, Mario Chalmers, Jun 25, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Shane Battier on James Jones, Mike Miller
item.description:
“I think he's sort of the key to that lineup. We could do it now, but I think our depth would be tested. With Mike Miller, I think we're a little more flexible with another handler. We could do it with James Jones to a lesser extent. That would entail somewhat of a shift in the rotation.”

Shane Battier on James Jones, Mike Miller, Apr 2, 2012. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: LeBron James on James Jones, Mike Miller, Mike Bibby
item.description:
“When I have new teammates, it’s a harder adjustment at the beginning because they’re not used to getting so many open looks. Mike Bibby, Mike Miller, [ James Jones] — these guys are getting so many open looks because me and D-Wade attract so many eyes.”

LeBron James on James Jones, Mike Miller, Mike Bibby, Mar 25, 2011. Source: Miami Herald.
